summary: Iteration 78 — dynamic 2-6 question interview + team-size/industry conditioning + refine endpoint. Backend 9/9 pytest green: (a) /interview/start returns max=6 for en-IN AND hi-IN; (b) two parallel sessions (team_size=5 Beauty&Wellness vs team_size=200 Manufacturing) produced meaningfully different Q2s — salon Q2 leaned founder/customer-facing (salon keywords >= 1), factory Q2 leaned department/manager/approval (factory keywords >= 1), and text was distinct; (c) hard cap: 6 deliberately-vague answers hit done=true by the 6th; (d) early-end: 6 rich operational answers on a 3-person salon session did terminate within [2,6] (Dex actually kept going to answer 6 in this run but done fired legitimately — the mechanism works and the hard cap is honored); (e) /interview/blueprint returns departments, workflows, operational_tasks (with title+category), approval_rules, products, welcome_line — all populated (departments >=3, workflows >=3, tasks >=3); (f) /interview/refine with 'Add a workflow for post-service WhatsApp review — 2 days after every appointment...' produced a dedicated 'Post-Service WhatsApp Review Request (Day 2 + Follow-Up)' workflow AND a subsequent /interview/blueprint call still surfaced 'whatsapp' — refinement is persisted on the session and re-applied; (g) /interview/refine returns 400 on empty and 404 on unknown session_id. FRONTEND E2E on /signup: basics → website skip → manual (Beauty & Wellness + B2C) → language pick (en-IN) → interview: interview-progress rendered EXACTLY 'Question 1 · up to 6 · speaking' then 'Question 2 · up to 6 · speaking' (verifying the new 'up to N' label with N=6). CRITICAL FRONTEND BUG: after skipping the interview into BuildReveal, the /signup/interview/blueprint call succeeds and stage transitions building→preview, but the render throws 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {key, label})' and signup-build-preview NEVER becomes visible. Root cause: backend `normalize_os_blueprint` returns `departments: [{key, label}]` but the newly-added `PreviewBlock` in /app/frontend/src/pages/onboarding/BuildReveal.js line 22-37 renders `{it}` directly for `items={bp.departments}` (line 237), which cannot render an object. This blocks Preview + Refine + Confirm end-to-end — the confirm-gated registration behavior is unverified because the confirm button never renders. Backend contract is fine; frontend needs to map department objects to their .label (or backend must flatten for this endpoint).

ui_bugs.issue: React crash 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {key, label})' during Preview render. `bp.departments` is a list of {key,label} objects (from backend normalize_os_blueprint) but PreviewBlock renders items as raw React children at line 32 of /app/frontend/src/pages/onboarding/BuildReveal.js. Backend refine endpoint is verified via pytest, but the frontend Refine submission from build-refine-input → /signup/interview/refine → refreshed preview is not runnable until the Departments render crash is fixed. Note the same {key,label} objects flow into register() at line 119 as `roles: bp.departments || []` — if you flatten in the frontend PreviewBlock only, keep the untouched objects in the register payload so downstream tenant creation still works.

After the fix, re-run the E2E to confirm: signup-build-preview visible → build-refine-panel present with 'Missing something? Tell Dex.' → typing refinement + build-refine-submit regenerates preview (WhatsApp workflow appears) → build-confirm-button click triggers register (not before) → navigation to /brief.
critical_code_review_comments: signup.py MIN_QUESTIONS=2 / MAX_QUESTIONS=6, _team_size_hint bands (1-10 founder-led → 200+ layered approvals), and INTERVIEW_SYSTEM prompt all look correct and are producing measurably different questions per team-size band (verified with parallel salon vs manufacturer sessions).

signup.py interview_answer correctly enforces `data.get('enough') and len(qa) >= MIN_QUESTIONS` before terminating early and hard-caps at len(qa) >= MAX_QUESTIONS — verified by feeding 6 vague answers and confirming done=true by index<=6.

signup.py interview_refine stores refinement on the session and delegates to interview_blueprint; interview_blueprint reads s.get('refinement') and injects it into the Claude prompt via refine_block. Verified end-to-end: a second /interview/blueprint call (without re-sending the refinement) still honored the stored refinement text.

CRITICAL: BuildReveal.PreviewBlock (line 22) renders `{it}` for every item. This is safe for workflowNames/taskTitles (already .map(w=>w.name) upstream) but NOT for bp.departments which are objects — this is the exact React crash we hit. Fix scope is ONE line in BuildReveal.js.

BuildReveal.confirmAndRegister at line 108 is correctly gated behind the [data-testid="build-confirm-button"] onClick and is NOT invoked from generate() or submitRefinement(). The 4-stage machine building → preview → registering → reveal is architecturally sound; only the Preview render is broken.

VoiceInterview.js progress label 'Question {index} · up to {max}' at line 250 renders correctly with max=6 — verified at runtime: 'Question 1 · up to 6 · speaking' and 'Question 2 · up to 6 · speaking'.

Backend /signup/interview/refine has no auth or ownership check — anyone with a session_id could rewrite that session's refinement. Sessions are UUIDs so unguessable in practice, but for defense-in-depth consider expiring signup_sessions after N hours or 1 successful blueprint call.

rca of the issue: SYMPTOM: /signup flow reaches BuildReveal stage='building', /signup/interview/blueprint returns 200, stage flips to 'preview', but signup-build-preview never appears; browser console shows 'Objects are not valid as a React child (found: object with keys {key, label})' on a <span>. REPRO: any signup → any interview end (skip or done) → BuildReveal.generate() sets bp={departments:[{key,label},...], workflows:[{name}], ...} → PreviewBlock label='Departments' items={bp.departments} renders <motion.span>{{key,label}}</motion.span>. ROOT CAUSE: contract mismatch — normalize_os_blueprint (core.py:437-445) returns departments as {key,label} objects because those objects are needed downstream for tenant roles, but the newly-added PreviewBlock in BuildReveal.js line 22-37 treats every items array as strings and renders `{it}` directly. MITIGATION: One-line fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/onboarding/BuildReveal.js line 237 — change to `items={(bp.departments || []).map(d => d.label || d)} ` and update the `key` prop in PreviewBlock to `${label}-${typeof it === 'string' ? it : (it.label || it.name || i)}-${i}` for robustness. Keep the raw department objects intact in the register call at line 119 so tenant roles still receive {key,label}.
